title: TurnIntake v1
description: What the intake seam hands to the rest of the engine for one turn. Status: DRAFT (E0), implemented at E2. One turn = one ContextPlan, obtained once from walter-context /preflight; later steps of the turn never ask again.

session_id.description: Stable engine session id: <interface>/<account or caller>/<conversation>. Fixed by intake, never by the model.

kind.description: owner = the instance's person; machine = a Walter module or schedule; test = Lab/bench (never production data writes)

id.description: Instance-relative identity (never a path, never a secret)

run_id.description: Run Plane run (runs.start through the Memory gateway); exactly one per turn

owner_text.description: The owner's message alone, separated from runtime notices (owner-turn)

fast_path_answer.description: Set when the plan's fast_path is served without a model; the turn then ends

thread_hint.description: ThreadHint v1 from walter-context (threads belong to Memory)

observation.description: Shadow/observation mode: computes and records under a shadow marker, writes nothing to business data or the production bus
